note: Scoring only; never read when building prompts. 'reference' is the graded-correct answer on the original evidence (rubric-direct: a rubric line states it; rubric-inferred: forced by the rubric's $1,303,717.70 subtotal, which equals the carried $1,276,934 plus exactly the 2.35/2.36/2.38/2.03 changes). 'sensitivity' is what the instruction's rules require on the modified evidence and is written to hold under any reasonable reading, so a miss means the decision did not follow the decisive evidence. 'delta' criteria compare the change from the model's own baseline answer.

D2-2.36.why: S-7 is no longer a manhole, so 9 of the 10 manholes remain.

D3-2.38.why: S-14 depth (rim minus invert out) grows by 1.00 ft, so depth beyond 10 ft grows by 1.00 VF.

W1-2.06.why: Moving S-8 4.00 ft downstream lengthens the S-5 to S-8 reach by 4.00 ft on a tangent, under any length method.

W2-2.08.why: Moving S-8 4.00 ft downstream shortens the S-8 to S-14 reach by 4.00 ft on a tangent, under any length method.

W3-2.44.why: The plans now give an explicit excavation quantity for the item, which governs over the carried figure and over any conversion of storage volume.
